description: This Java class implements a listener for global property changes related to logging configuration in the OpenMRS platform. It reacts to updates, deletions, and supports specific property names to dynamically adjust logging levels and settings.

classes.name: LoggingConfigurationGlobalPropertyListener
classes.description: Implements a listener reacting to logging-related global property changes, updating logger configurations dynamically.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Determines if the given property name is supported by this listener, specifically log level, layout, and location settings.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when a global property has changed; updates logging levels or configurations accordingly.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a global property, resetting internal cached values and reloading logging configuration.
